title: Tokens by model
description: Input plus output tokens over time, by model.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(time), ' ', to_string(model)) AS k FROM (SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, tags['model'] AS model, to_int64(sum(metric_value)) AS tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND metric_name IN ('llm.input_tokens', 'llm.output_tokens') GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time) ORDER BY time

title: Tokens by type
description: Input, output, cache read and cache write tokens over time, as each agent reports them. Codex counts cache reads inside its input tokens.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(time), ' ', to_string(token_type)) AS k FROM (SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, replace_one(replace_one(metric_name, 'llm.', ''), '_tokens', '') AS token_type, to_int64(sum(metric_value)) AS tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND metric_name IN ('llm.input_tokens', 'llm.output_tokens', 'llm.cache_read_tokens', 'llm.cache_write_tokens') GROUP BY time, token_type ORDER BY time) ORDER BY time

title: Cache hit ratio by model
description: Share of the prompt read from the cache.
viz_content: SELECT to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) AS time, tags['model'] AS model, round(100 * sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_read_tokens') / greatest(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens') + sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_read_tokens' AND agent_type != 'codex'), 1), 1) AS cache_hit_pct FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND metric_name LIKE 'llm.%' GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

title: Model request latency (p95) by model
description: 95th percentile of the model request time.
viz_content: SELECT to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) AS time, tags['model'] AS model, round(quantile(0.95)(metric_value)) AS p95_ms FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND metric_name = 'llm.latency_ms' GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

title: Usage by model
description: Model requests and tokens for the eight most used models in the selected window.
viz_content: SELECT tags['model'] AS model, any(tags['provider']) AS provider, count_if(metric_name = 'llm.call') AS calls, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens')) AS input_tokens, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.output_tokens')) AS output_tokens, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_read_tokens')) AS cache_read_tokens, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_write_tokens')) AS cache_write_tokens, round(100 * sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_read_tokens') / greatest(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens') + sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_read_tokens' AND agent_type != 'codex'), 1), 1) AS cache_hit_pct, round(quantile_if(0.5)(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.latency_ms')) AS p50_ms, round(quantile_if(0.95)(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.latency_ms')) AS p95_ms FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND metric_name LIKE 'llm.%' GROUP BY model ORDER BY input_tokens DESC LIMIT 8

title: Sessions using the most tokens
description: The eight sessions with the most input tokens in the selected window.
viz_content: SELECT session_id, any(agent_type) AS agent, any(tags['model']) AS model, count_if(metric_name = 'llm.call') AS calls, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens')) AS input_tokens, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.output_tokens')) AS output_tokens, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_read_tokens')) AS cache_read_tokens, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name IN ('llm.input_tokens', 'llm.output_tokens')) / greatest(count_if(metric_name = 'llm.call'), 1)) AS tokens_per_call FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND metric_name LIKE 'llm.%' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY input_tokens DESC LIMIT 8
